product_description.value:
A large bamboo chopping board with a juice groove on one side, made from moso bamboo with a mineral oil finish.

It measures 38 x 28 x 1.8 cm and weighs 900 g. Hand wash it and dry it upright, re-oil it once a month, and keep it out of the dishwasher: it is not dishwasher safe.
